text:
Instruments & Control
Technical Procedure
Model No. C6920
Introduction
This document out lines the equipment inspection 
II, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
There are six monitors ( the same type )
The first 
draft is initiated by eng. 
Taher Abd Elgalel 
, tested by eng. 
Wagdy Eid Mansour, 
reviewed by EDEPC quality control eng. Abd El-Monem 
El-Emam, accepted by general director eng. Yousry Abd El-Maksoud, revised by 
eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS 
coordinator, approved by eng. Awad Fathy 
Talkha PS head sector, and certified by 
accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; general director of Admin.& Financial 
quality control, and supervisor of EDEPC inspection & quality control Head 
sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
Unit must be shut down.
Tools and Equipment
Suitable 
 tool set
Suitable 
 tool set
Digital voltmeter
Air Blower.
Work to be Carried Out
Disconnect power and data cables from monitor.
Disassemble screen & power supply.
Clean the monitor & power supply using air 
 blower.
Disassemble the power supply unit and the CRT.
Test the power supply and check if the voltage is within the limits of ( 160 
 , 100 , 170 , 6 , 25 , 18 ) VDC + 10%.
If the voltage is OK that's mean the power 
 supply is ok, if not adjust from the potentiometer.
 Note: If we can not adjust you must change 
 the power supply.
Reassemble power supply to screen.
Reassemble screen in the same position.
Connect all cable to screen.
Reconnect power to it.
Adjust screen, focus, and brightness (vertical & 
 horizontal).
Reconnect power to power supply unit and adjust it according to step 5.
